translated_text: My darling, 9. 1, 40 IV. Yesterday I was a little tired. Yes, I didn't write to you. Today I'm back at the office. I received two cards (photos) and one letter. – But why don't you send me photos of yourself? Are they so bad?! – I'll wait until the 15th to go and see. Maybe we'll be able to ask your permission. I'll send you the books you asked for tomorrow, no doubt. I put myself in Paris to pay them 120. – It's still wonderful, everything has become so hard. We don't do enough anymore; the smallest things cost a fortune. – You don't realize it there, but here it's terrible. – I spoke with Irma to keep quiet. – It will pass one day. – But when?? I'm so glad you're so kind and the others are so unpleasant. My darling, I adore you and think of my little heart that encloses me; it feels entirely good in your little heart, so good - my darling, your Baba - Anand us for day mos?
